items.title: Aday Mara had 15 points, 13 rebounds and 1 block as Spain lost to Greece today.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Aday Mara had 15 points, 13 rebounds and 1 block as Spain lost to Greece today.

Sergia De Larrea had 9 points. Baba Miller had 4 points and 5 rebounds.

Hugo Gonzalez had 4 points, 3 rebounds and 1 block.
